blocks.text: The Qingleng Feng (清冷风, lit "clear-cold style") character is a common character trope seen in Wuxia and Xianxia drama, featuring aloof quiet mannerisms, pale delicate facial features, ethereal cool-toned costumes, and an overall detached, restrained and otherworldly aura.
History

Characters with such personality have long been a staple in Chinese literature. Xiaolongnü from the novel The Return of the Condor Heroes and its screen adaptations firmly tied the visual of white fashion to the personality. The wave of screen adaptations of Wuxia and Xianxia novels, comics, and web-fiction in the 21st century further consolidate this visual trope.

In the 2010s, it spawned a broad descriptive fashion label of the same name that rejects ornate decorations and opt for refined elegance marked by restraint. Merging with Minimalism and Wabi-Sabi, the fashion label did not form a standalone distinctive aesthetic.
After the 2015 drama The Journey of Flower, white costumes became overused in Xianxia drama, which has diluted the connection to personality of this visual symbol.
Personality

In terms of personality, this character trope is a sub-genre of an Ice Queen, who keeps their emotions reserved and possesses a natural unapproachable aura. The character is usually smart, independent, and respectfully aloof. In Wuxia or Xianxia settings the character is skilled in martial arts or extraordinary power.
Fashion
Under Construction Bearing similarities to the Ice Queen and The Stoic, the qingleng character trope carries more explicitly defined fashion associations.
White and pale blue palette
Draping quality and clean lines
No elaborate lace, prints
High collars
Hanfu
Minimalist commuter wear, e.g. school uniform, trench coat
Cotton and linen, matte drapable fabrics
Plain jade or slim silver bracelet
Other Visuals
Atmosphere Elements：Falling snow, moonlit night, morning mist, overcast rain, quiet and empty scenes with no one around.
Ancient Settings: study, woods
Modern Settings：library, streetside, riverside, quiet corner of a cold café
Criticism
Under Construction This character trope is criticized for being overused, while the overuse of white costumes is criticized for lacking dedication to character design.
